rules.invariant: Mobile writes use the existing live socket; HTTP shares only reads and documented non-phone tool operations.
rules.fix: Send phone operations through LiveConnection.request. Keep HTTP limited to its documented non-phone tool commands; do not add another sender. Rooms MCP retains its separate authenticated tool boundary.

rules.invariant: Agent queue items are appended only by the conversational queue owner; only an item authorizes a turn.
rules.fix: Call queueMessage in apps/server/src/agent-command.ts; it owns membership, source/return addresses and durable append.

rules.invariant: The queue has no claimed state: nothing assigns state='claimed'.
rules.fix: Items stay pending until their answer is posted; deliver them from getAgentCommands without claiming.

rules.invariant: The queue has no generation, lease or owner: nothing writes those retired columns.
rules.fix: Identify a queue item by its id and requestId; it carries no generation, lease or owner.

rules.invariant: MCP transport adapters never write command or turn state; only command/receipt owners settle work.
rules.fix: Use the queue owners (selectMcpOrder, dismissAgentCommandWakes, endAgentTurn) or postAgentTurnReceipt; MCP may only adapt ingress.

rules.invariant: Actionable subscriptions live in agent_subscriptions; old JSON is upgrade input only.
rules.fix: Read roomEventSubscriptions or subscriptionRooms from agent-subscriptions.ts; do not dispatch from old membership JSON.

rules.invariant: Corner state (corner_facts) is written only by the corner module.
rules.fix: Emit an event through advanceCorner in apps/server/src/corner-lifecycle.ts.

rules.invariant: GitHub's corner display cache (corner_github_cache) is written only from GitHub, helper remote-state reports and the corner module's seed and close.
rules.fix: Write the cache through apps/server/src/corner-github-cache.ts (writeCornerGithubCache, recordHelperRemoteState) or GitHubOperations in apps/server/src/github-operations.ts; read it with cornerLifecycleSql.

rules.invariant: Merge yeses (corner_merge_approvals) are written only by the merge-approval module.
rules.fix: Record or withdraw a yes through apps/server/src/corner-merge-approval.ts (recordCornerMergeApproval, withdrawAgentMergeApprovals, withdrawPullRequestMergeApprovals, withdrawMergeApprovalsBy). If it lacks the write you need, add a named function there and call it.

rules.invariant: Merge holds (corner_merge_holds) are written only by the holds module.
rules.fix: Set or release a hold through apps/server/src/corner-holds.ts (setCornerHold, releaseArchivedCornerHolds, collapseTombstonedCornerHolds). If it lacks the write you need, add a named function there and call it.

rules.invariant: Only archiveCornerState archives a corner, with commands, workflow runs, wakes and holds in one transaction.
rules.fix: Emit closed or merged through advanceCorner in corner-lifecycle.ts; its archiveCorner effect owns command, workflow and hold cleanup.

rules.invariant: A pull request is merged only through GitHubOperations.landCorner.
rules.fix: Merge through GitHubOperations.landCorner, the only merge path (AGENTS.md merge authority); it checks the exact-head yes, green checks and holds.

rules.invariant: Live notifications are published only by postgres-live.ts, so its decoder sees every event.
rules.fix: Publish through a named notifier in apps/server/src/postgres-live.ts (add one beside notifyConnectorAssignment) and call it, so LiveNotification and its decoder cover the event.

rules.invariant: Server work runs only on events or owner-created schedules.
rules.fix: Delete the interval. Use the committed event that authorizes the work.

rules.invariant: Server timers belong only to owner-created schedules and bounded process shutdown.
rules.fix: Drive work from its source event. Only owner-schedule-clock.ts and shutdown.ts own schedule and shutdown deadlines.

rules.invariant: Memberships are written only by the membership module.
rules.fix: Change membership through a named helper in apps/server/src/membership-join.ts (add one there if needed) and call it.

rules.invariant: The server and shared contract never branch on a harness name; harness behaviour lives in the helper's AgentKind tables.
rules.fix: Send the server a capability or setting, not the harness name, and keep the per-harness value in a Record<AgentKind, ...> table beside AGENT_KINDS in apps/body/src/agent-command.ts.

rules.invariant: Helper behaviour per harness is read from AgentKind tables, not from scattered harness-name comparisons.
rules.fix: Add the behaviour as a field of a Record<AgentKind, ...> table beside AGENT_KINDS in apps/body/src/agent-command.ts and read that field here instead of comparing the harness name.

rules.invariant: Only an explicit socket request outcome may publish the app connection error.

rules.invariant: Connection failure copy and the connection failure hook belong only to the app-wide banner.
rules.pattern: Beeline (?:isn[\x27’]t|is not) connected|Could(?:n[\x27’]t| not) reach Beeline|[Cc]heck your connection|Showing saved messages|connectionError(?:Title|Description)|\buseConnectionFailure\s*\(|No connection to the server|Not connected yet|No connection(?!s)|You[’']re offline
rules.fix: Use the one ConnectionStatus in the app layout. Keep screen errors specific to server refusals or failed actions; do not duplicate connection errors.

rules.invariant: The app layout mounts exactly one connection banner.
rules.fix: Remove the additional connection banner. The app layout owns the only mount.

rules.invariant: Only beeline_finish_agent_command changes a command to a terminal state.
rules.fix: Call endAgentTurn or beeline_finish_agent_command in the caller's transaction; a dropped helper leaves the item pending.

rules.invariant: The turn-ending owner records terminal answers and interrupted executions.
rules.fix: Call endAgentTurn or beeline_finish_agent_command in the caller's transaction; a dropped helper leaves the item pending.

rules.invariant: Turns are started as working; terminal turns are written only by beeline_end_agent_turn.
rules.fix: Insert working turns only; finish them through endAgentTurn.

rules.invariant: Commands are created pending; only beeline_end_agent_turn writes terminal commands.
rules.fix: Insert pending commands; end them through endAgentTurn.

rules.invariant: Only agent-process.ts calls ACP process lifecycle primitives; acp.ts defines them. Work starts processes and one warm countdown retires them.
rules.fix: Use startAgentProcess/stopAgentProcess in apps/body/src/agent-process.ts. Do not add another ACP process lifecycle caller.

rules.invariant: Tracked code files have at most 1000 lines.
rules.fix: Split the file by domain without changing behavior.

rules.invariant: Shutdown owns exactly the request drain, process deadline and live-close deadline.
rules.fix: Keep the three bounded shutdown deadlines in shutdown.ts; do not add retry or background clocks.
